title: Decker, a platform that builds on the legacy of Hypercard and classic macOS
summary:
Decker is a free, open-source multimedia platform for creating interactive documents like E-Zines, games, and presentations. It draws inspiration from HyperCard and classic MacOS, offering a nostalgic “ditherpunk” aesthetic, deep undo history, modern keyboard/touch support, and bulk editing. Finished projects can be saved as self-contained HTML files that run in any browser, or used natively on MacOS, Windows, BSD, and Linux.

Decker features a novel scripting language, Lil, influenced by Lua and Q, which includes implicit scalar-vector arithmetic and a SQL-like query language. It provides built-in interactive widgets, custom widget definitions that can be copied and shared as text, and a command-line tool (Lilt) for headless manipulation and scripting. Documents use a line-oriented text format compatible with Git/SVN.

The platform has no advertising, telemetry, or user-tracking. It includes extensive documentation, example projects (e.g., Sokoban, Breakout, a CHIP-8 interpreter), and libraries for plotting, statistics, animation, pathfinding, and more. Source code is available on GitHub (MIT license), and binary releases for MacOS and Windows are on Itch.io, which also hosts a community forum and regular “Decker Fantasy Camp” game jams (next: July 2026).

title: Design is compromise
summary: The article argues that "compromise" is unfairly vilified, when in fact it is an unavoidable part of decision-making and good design. Compromise is simply prioritization—choosing one thing over another. Companies often market products as "uncompromising," but that is impossible; every choice inherently rejects alternatives. A better term is "tradeoff," which clarifies that you are exchanging a weakness for a strength. Opinionated designs excel by being clearly weaker in some areas in order to be significantly stronger in others. Trying to appeal to everyone results in mediocrity—a compromise in itself. The key to good design is making the right tradeoffs for your audience, not avoiding compromise altogether.
chinese_title: 设计是妥协
chinese_summary: 文章指出，“妥协”一词被不公平地污名化，而实际上它是决策和优秀设计中不可避免的一部分。妥协不过是优先级排序——在两者之间做出选择。企业常常将产品标榜为“不妥协”，但这根本不可能；每一个选择都天然地拒绝了其他选项。更合适的说法是“权衡”，它清晰地表明你是在用弱点换取优势。有主见的设计之所以出色，正是因为它在某些方面明显较弱，从而在其他方面显著更强。试图取悦所有人只会导致平庸——这本身就是一种妥协。优秀设计的关键在于为你的受众做出正确的权衡，而非完全避免妥协。

title: London Gatwick has launched a robotic airport parking service
summary:
London Gatwick has become the first UK airport to introduce robotic parking, launching a service in partnership with Stanley Robotics. Passengers drive into a private cabin near the South Terminal, park, and keep their keys. An autonomous robot slides under the vehicle, lifts it by its tyres, and transports it to a secure storage area. The system uses passengers’ return flight details to have the car waiting in a collection cabin upon their return. The facility is within walking distance of the terminal, with a free shuttle bus also available.

Unlike traditional valet parking, customers retain their keys throughout, offering extra peace of mind. On-site staff can retrieve emergency items if needed. Robotic parking maximises space efficiency by allowing cars to be parked closer together, increasing capacity without new infrastructure. The service is available for most standard cars, subject to limits: max weight 2.6 tonnes, height 2.3 metres, wheelbase 3.3 metres, and wheel diameter 21 inches. Same-day drive-up parking is not available; advance booking is required.

Gatwick’s Head of Airport Access, Oli Bedford, called it “a real game-changer,” while Stanley Robotics CEO Clément Boussard highlighted its role in addressing future parking demand as the airport grows. This marks Stanley Robotics’ first UK airport deployment, following similar international installations.

title: What does GitHub's security team even do?
summary: The article criticizes GitHub’s security team for failing to proactively combat malware repositories. The author demonstrates that thousands of repositories distributing trojans are easily found using simple GitHub search queries (e.g., `path:readme.md "## 📥 Download"`). These repos share a consistent pattern: a readme with an emoji heading and a link to a zip archive containing malicious files. After discovering and publishing a list of 10,000 such repositories—along with a detection script—the article reached Hacker News’ front page. GitHub’s only response was to delete those specific repos within hours. However, when the author re‑ran the script, new malicious repos appeared and remained unblocked for an entire month, despite the same pattern being publicly documented. The article questions why GitHub—with billions in revenue, a dedicated security team, and AI tools—cannot implement ongoing monitoring or quickly address newly reported threats. The author speculates that bureaucratic inertia or lack of initiative may be to blame, contrasting GitHub’s swift one‑time deletion with its failure to establish a sustainable detection process.

title: Jimothy the raccoon has a rare spinal condition. Here's what that means
summary:
Jimothy, a raccoon from Seattle, has become an internet sensation due to his unusually round, neckless appearance caused by a rare genetic condition called short spine syndrome. Ecologist Julian Avery explains that the condition results from a faulty recessive gene, leading to shortened or fused vertebrae. Despite his odd shape, Jimothy appears healthy—able to forage, climb, and move normally—with no compromised brain or internal organs. His adaptability as a raccoon species also aids his survival.

The main risk to Jimothy is not his condition but human interference. Feeding him could make him less wary of threats like cars or wildlife removal. Experts, including the Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife, urge a hands-off approach: admire from a respectful distance without intervening. Jimothy’s fame continues, with a city council member proclaiming “Jimothy Summer” and a community art competition. His discoverer, Kiana Hall, hopes his story encourages people to appreciate local wildlife responsibly.

title: The relay market powering token resellers and fraud
summary:
The article exposes a thriving underground relay market that resells discounted access to AI models like OpenAI and Anthropic. Relays (or “transfer stations”) proxy traffic to U.S. models at up to 97.8% off official pricing, using stolen, leaked, or pooled API keys. The ecosystem has four layers: upstream card/account merchants selling virtual credit cards and bulk accounts; midstream account pools aggregating and managing hundreds of accounts; downstream relays wrapping pools into billed, Chinese-language products; and end users—developers, startups, and commercial buyers using the infrastructure for cheap inference and model distillation.

Most relays run on open-source gateways (one-api or new-api), which are legitimate tools but become illicit when stocked with unauthorized keys. Common abuse methods include free-trial automation, chargeback attacks, prepaid cards, and open inference. A new tactic, “denial of wallet,” floods a provider with requests to burn its spend.

The market is mature and growing: price-comparison sites, affiliate programs, and even a daily lottery for 50 $100 API keys exist. The top ten relays attract 3.6 million monthly visits. Providers can defend by raising entry costs, monitoring payments and behavior, clustering accounts, and enforcing spend caps, but fraud remains a persistent cat-and-mouse game. The author predicts abuse will shift as KYC controls roll out.

title: Go Analysis Framework: modular static analysis by go team
summary:
The article describes the **Go Analysis Framework**, a modular static analysis system built around two core types: `Analyzer` and `Pass`.

- **Analyzer** defines an analysis: its name, documentation, flags, dependencies, and `Run` function. An example is the `unusedresult` checker. Analyzers can declare required dependencies, result types, and fact types. The driver (e.g., `vet`) imports and runs a list of analyzers.

- **Pass** represents analyzing a single package. It provides syntax trees, type information, and methods to report diagnostics (`Report`, `Reportf`). The `ResultOf` map gives access to results from required analyzers. Diagnostics include position, optional category, and message.

- **Modular analysis** is achieved with **Facts**—serializable, stateless information (e.g., “this function is a printf wrapper”) associated with objects or packages. Facts are exported/imported via `ExportObjectFact`, `ImportObjectFact`, etc. They enable inter-package analysis, akin to separate compilation.

- **Testing** is simplified using the `analysistest` subpackage, which checks expected diagnostics and facts via `// want ...` comments.

- **Standalone commands** are built with `singlechecker` (for one analyzer) or `multichecker` (for many), making it easy to create custom analysis tools.

The framework emphasizes modularity, reusability, and driver flexibility, supporting tools from CLI to IDEs.
chinese_title: Go分析框架：Go团队的模块化静态分析
chinese_summary:
文章介绍了**Go分析框架**，这是一个模块化的静态分析系统，围绕两个核心类型构建：`Analyzer`（分析器）和`Pass`（分析通行证）。

- **Analyzer**定义了一项分析：其名称、文档、标志、依赖项以及`Run`函数。例如`unusedresult`检查器。分析器可以声明所需的依赖项、结果类型和事实类型。驱动程序（如`vet`）导入并运行一系列分析器。

- **Pass**表示对单个包的分析。它提供语法树、类型信息以及报告诊断的方法（`Report`、`Reportf`）。`ResultOf`映射用于访问所需分析器的结果。诊断信息包括位置、可选的类别和消息。

- **模块化分析**通过**事实**实现——与对象或包相关联的可序列化、无状态信息（例如“该函数是一个printf包装器”）。事实通过`ExportObjectFact`、`ImportObjectFact`等导出/导入。它们支持跨包分析，类似于独立编译。

- **测试**通过`analysistest`子包简化，该子包通过`// want ...`注释检查预期的诊断和事实。

- **独立命令**使用`singlechecker`（用于单个分析器）或`multichecker`（用于多个分析器）构建，从而轻松创建自定义分析工具。

该框架强调模块化、可复用性和驱动灵活性，支持从命令行到IDE的各种工具。

title: Building the Grace Cathedral Experience
summary:
The article describes how PlayCanvas and Vincent Woo’s 3D Gaussian splat capture of San Francisco’s Grace Cathedral were turned into an interactive browser experience. Key technical highlights:

- **WebGPU Hybrid Renderer**: Uses compute shaders to cull, project, and sort splats on the GPU each frame, avoiding CPU bottlenecks and outperforming the WebGL 2 fallback. Both WGSL and GLSL shaders support dual paths.

- **Streamed SOG Format**: Delivers splat data in chunked levels of detail. The exterior loads a 400m LOD set plus a static background; interior loads separately. Startup fetches only a coarse LOD for fast first pixel, then refines within device budgets (3.5M splats desktop, 1.4M mobile). Mode switches use a freeze-fade transition.

- **Optimizations**: On-demand rendering stops when camera is idle; resolution caps on high-DPI displays; depth pre-pass occlusion using an interior collision mesh.

- **Scene Features**:  
  – **Peek effect**: Carves away the nearest wall using box-based cutout shaders with a glowing rim.  
  – **Hidden flag**: Splats inside an authored box animate with a traveling wave.  
  – **Traffic**: Isolated car splats from the original capture spawn at intervals.  
  – **Camera navigation**: Exterior orbit follows a rounded-box envelope; scripted flights use waypoint graphs and cubic splines.  
  – **Soundscape**: City loops crossfade with altitude; interior ambience and footstep sounds.

- **Open Source**: Built entirely on PlayCanvas Engine, SuperSplat Editor, and open SOG format, all available for reuse.
chinese_title: 打造恩典大教堂体验
chinese_summary:
本文介绍了如何将 PlayCanvas 与 Vincent Woo 对旧金山恩典大教堂的 3D 高斯泼溅捕捉相结合，打造出交互式浏览器体验。关键技术亮点如下：

- **WebGPU 混合渲染器**：利用计算着色器在每一帧对 GPU 上的泼溅点进行剔除、投影和排序，避免了 CPU 瓶颈，性能优于 WebGL 2 回退方案。WGSL 和 GLSL 着色器均支持双路径。

- **流式 SOG 格式**：以分块细节层次传输泼溅数据。外部加载 400 米 LOD 集及静态背景；内部独立加载。启动时仅获取粗略 LOD 实现首帧快速显示，随后根据设备预算（桌面端 350 万泼溅点，移动端 140 万）逐步细化。模式切换采用冻结淡入淡出过渡。

- **优化**：相机静止时按需渲染暂停；高 DPI 显示屏上限制分辨率；利用内部碰撞网格进行深度预通过遮挡。

- **场景特性**：
  – **窥视效果**：使用基于盒体的剪切着色器配合发光边缘，移除最近的墙壁。
  – **隐藏标记**：位于设定盒体内部的泼溅点呈现移动波动动画。
  – **车流**：从原始捕捉中分离出的独立车辆泼溅点按间隔生成。
  – **相机导航**：外部环绕遵循圆角盒体轨迹；脚本化飞行采用路径点图与三次样条曲线。
  – **音景**：城市环境音随高度交叉淡入淡出；内部氛围音与脚步声。

- **开源**：完全基于 PlayCanvas 引擎、SuperSplat 编辑器及开放 SOG 格式构建，所有内容均可复用。

title: How to Write English Prose
summary: David Bentley Hart's essay argues that great English prose navigates between two poles: the "beautiful" (ornate, decorative) and the "sublime" (restrained, majestic). He illustrates this with Sir Thomas Browne's lush, Baroque sentences and the King James Bible's luminous simplicity, both from the 17th century—a golden age when English had achieved full expressive power. Hart contends that modern prose has suffered from a rigid dogma of simplification, resulting in dull, anonymous writing. He advocates for a balanced interplay between complexity and clarity, noting that both require taste and skill. To demonstrate enduring excellence, he offers five exemplars: Robert Louis Stevenson, Sylvia Townsend Warner, J.A. Baker, and Patrick Leigh Fermor (the list is cut off but implies others). Their passages show how richness of vocabulary, cadence, and imagery can elevate prose without lapsing into either barren minimalism or overwrought excess. Hart's core message: good writing emerges not from abandoning ornament or restraint, but from masterfully orchestrating the tension between them.
chinese_title: 如何写英语散文
chinese_summary: 大卫·本特利·哈特的文章认为，优秀的英语散文在两个极端之间游走：“优美”（华丽、装饰性）与“崇高”（克制、庄严）。他以托马斯·布朗爵士繁复的巴洛克式句子和詹姆斯王钦定版圣经清澈简洁的语言为例，两者均出自17世纪——英语已获得充分表现力的黄金时代。哈特指出，现代散文因固守简化教条而变得枯燥乏味、千篇一律。他主张在复杂与清晰之间实现平衡互动，并强调二者皆需品味与技巧。为展示持久卓越的范例，他举出五位作家：罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森、西尔维亚·汤森德·华纳、J.A.贝克、帕特里克·利·费莫尔（名单至此中断，暗示还有他人）。他们的段落表明，丰富的词汇、节奏与意象如何提升散文，既避免陷入空洞的极简主义，也不流于过度雕琢。哈特的核心观点在于：好的写作并非源自放弃修饰或克制，而是源于巧妙驾驭二者之间的张力。

title: The Strongest El Niño Ever
summary: A July 2026 update from climate scientist Zeke Hausfather warns that this year's El Niño is on track to become the strongest ever recorded. Analyzing 667 ensemble members from 14 seasonal forecast models, the multi-model median peak for the Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature anomaly is 3.6°C—0.8°C above the prior record of 2.75°C set in 2015-16. The event is developing faster than the explosive 1997-98 El Niño, and even after removing the global warming trend (using the relative ONI index), models give a 77% chance of a record. Every individual model predicts a "super" El Niño, with 91% of members exceeding the 2015-16 peak. However, Hausfather cautions that no seasonal forecast system has ever verified such extreme conditions, so model agreement is not proof. Observed daily SSTs in July are already at 2°C above average—unprecedented for this time of year—and typical seasonal phasing suggests further intensification toward a November–January peak. The lagged effect on global temperatures means 2027 is likely to become the warmest year on record by a sizable margin, while 2026 now has a 28% chance of surpassing 2024.
chinese_title: 史上最强厄尔尼诺
chinese_summary: 气候科学家Zeke Hausfather在2026年7月的一份更新中警告称，今年的厄尔尼诺现象有望成为有记录以来最强的一次。通过对14个季节预报模型的667个集合成员进行分析，尼诺3.4海面温度异常的多模型集合中位数峰值达到3.6°C，比2015-16年创下的2.75°C此前纪录高出0.8°C。这一事件的发展速度比爆发性的1997-98年厄尔尼诺还要快，即便在消除全球变暖趋势后（使用相对ONI指数），模型预测有77%的概率打破纪录。每个单独模型都预测了一次“超级”厄尔尼诺，其中91%的集合成员超过了2015-16年的峰值。然而，Hausfather提醒道，没有任何季节预报系统曾验证过如此极端的情况，因此模型的一致性并不能作为证据。7月观测到的每日海温已经比平均水平高出2°C——这在一年中的这个时期是前所未有的——而典型的季节性相位表明，强度将进一步增强，并在11月至1月达到峰值。对全球气温的滞后效应意味着，2027年很可能以较大幅度成为有记录以来最暖的一年，而2026年目前有28%的概率超过2024年。

title: The New AI Superpowers: Focus and Followthrough
summary:
The article argues that while AI dramatically boosts task efficiency (2-100x), it paradoxically increases burnout if misused. The author shares his personal experience: AI enabled him to start dozens of side projects (“ALL THE THINGS”), but each project became an open loop, creating endless make-work. This led to burnout despite doing tasks faster.

The key insight is that productivity gains should not be used to expand horizontally (more projects), but to go deeper vertically on what truly matters. Drawing from Greg McKeown’s *Essentialism*, the author advocates for “less, but better”: ruthless focus and followthrough. He illustrates this with a “partial vs. total eclipse” analogy—the last 1% of effort often delivers a 100x difference in impact, but many settle for “good enough.” With AI making the final polish easier, there is no excuse to skip it.

The solution: publish fewer articles, but make each one deeper; prioritize quality over quantity. The ultimate goal is to avoid burnout by using AI to offload labor, save time, and be more human—not to fuel endless new pursuits.
chinese_title: 新AI超级力量：专注与贯彻
chinese_summary:
文章认为，AI虽能将任务效率提升2到100倍，但若使用不当反而会加剧倦怠。作者分享自身经历：AI让他同时启动数十个副项目（"所有事情都做"），但每个项目都成了未闭环的任务，催生无尽的无用功。尽管做事更快，却仍导致心力交瘁。

核心启示在于：效率提升不应被用于横向扩张（增加项目数量），而应聚焦纵向深耕真正重要之事。借鉴格雷格·麦基翁的《精要主义》，作者倡导"更少，但更好"：极致的专注与跟进。他以"日偏食与日全食"作比——最后1%的努力往往能带来100倍的影响力差异，但多数人止步于"差不多就好"。既然AI让最终打磨变得轻松，更无理由跳过这关键一步。

解决方案：减少发文数量，但每篇更具深度；质量优先于数量。终极目标是通过AI解放劳力、节省时间、回归人性，而非催生永无止境的新追求——如此方能避免倦怠。

title: I learned PCB design, 3D printing and C just to listen to music
summary:
The article describes the creation of Pentaton LP, a custom music streamer designed to display full-size album artwork like a vinyl sleeve. The author, missing the tactile experience of LP covers, built a device around a 17-inch 1920x1920 IPS LCD with an embedded DisplayPort connector. They used a Radxa CM3 single-board computer and designed a custom carrier board—requiring four revisions to master high-speed signal routing. The enclosure, modeled in FreeCAD with a custom macro for curved surfaces, was 3D printed after learning design-for-manufacturing lessons.

The software runs a minimal Alpine Linux image with shairport-sync for AirPlay support. A custom application drives the display using GPU acceleration to smoothly cross-fade 4MP images at 60fps. Since AirPlay only transmits low-resolution artwork (≈500x500 pixels), the author built an out-of-band protocol extension in their audio player app to send full-resolution images.

The device stays on, consuming under 2 watts with the screen off, waking automatically when streaming begins and triggering an amplifier via a 12V output. It uses USB-C PD for power, an external DAC (FiiO KA17), and supports CD-quality lossless audio via AirPlay. The author is considering a Kickstarter campaign and invites sign-ups at pentaton.app/lp/.
chinese_title: 我学习PCB设计、3D打印和C语言只是为了听音乐。
chinese_summary:
文章描述了Pentaton LP的制作过程，这是一款自定义音乐流媒体播放器，旨在像黑胶唱片封套一样展示全尺寸专辑封面。作者怀念黑胶封套的触感体验，因此以一块配备嵌入式DisplayPort接口的17英寸1920x1920 IPS液晶屏为核心搭建了设备。他使用了Radxa CM3单板计算机，并自行设计了定制载板——经过四次修订才掌握高速信号布线技术。外壳则通过FreeCAD建模（借助自定义宏处理曲面），并在学习制造设计规范后通过3D打印完成。

软件方面运行精简版Alpine Linux系统，通过shairport-sync支持AirPlay。自定义应用程序利用GPU加速驱动显示屏，以60帧/秒的速度流畅交叉淡入淡出400万像素的图像。由于AirPlay仅传输低分辨率专辑封面（约500×500像素），作者在其音频播放器应用中构建了带外协议扩展，以发送全分辨率图像。

设备保持常开状态，屏幕关闭时功耗低于2瓦，当流媒体播放开始时自动唤醒，并通过12V输出触发功放。它采用USB-C PD供电，外接DAC（FiiO KA17），并支持通过AirPlay播放CD级无损音频。作者正在考虑发起Kickstarter众筹，并邀请用户在pentaton.app/lp/注册等候名单。

title: Kill The Cookie Banner
summary: The article advocates for eliminating misleading cookie banners by adopting browser-based privacy preference signals, as proposed by the EU Commission in autumn 2025 under the Digital Omnibus reform. Currently, cookie banners exploit users, with up to 90% consenting to tracking even though only about 3% actually want it. The solution would let users set privacy preferences once in their browser, automatically communicating them to websites—similar to language settings, and already legally supported in some US states. However, the tracking industry, led by Google and backed by several EU Member States, is lobbying against the proposal to maintain high consent rates. The European Parliament is also being pressured to reject it. Civil society organizations urge citizens to contact their representatives in the European Parliament or national governments to express frustration and support the initiative. The article notes that while the privacy signal proposal is welcome, other parts of the Digital Omnibus reform are problematic and could weaken rights.
chinese_title: 消灭Cookie横幅
chinese_summary: 这篇文章主张通过采用浏览器内置的隐私偏好信号来消除误导性的Cookie横幅，这一方案由欧盟委员会在2025年秋季的“数字综合改革”中提出。当前，Cookie横幅在欺骗用户，尽管实际上只有约3%的人愿意被追踪，但高达90%的用户被迫同意。该解决方案允许用户在浏览器中一次性设置隐私偏好，并自动将这些偏好传达给网站——类似于语言设置，且在美国部分州已获得法律支持。然而，以谷歌为首、并得到多个欧盟成员国支持的追踪行业正在游说反对该提案，以维持高同意率。欧洲议会也面临压力要求否决该提案。民间社会组织呼吁公民联系他们在欧洲议会或国家政府的代表，表达不满并支持这一倡议。文章指出，尽管隐私信号提案值得欢迎，但“数字综合改革”的其他部分存在问题，可能削弱用户权利。

title: Using ThinkPad T480 as a mobile phone
summary:
The article describes how a ThinkPad T480 laptop can be transformed into a fully functional mobile phone, capable of calls, SMS, and mobile data. The T480 includes a SIM card slot for LTE modems, but the audio transmission pins (PCM) are not connected. A bug in Intel Management Engine allows flashing Libreboot firmware, bypassing the wireless card whitelist and enabling the use of a custom modem.

The recommended modem is the Quectel EG25-G, used in the PinePhone. This modem contains an ARM core running Android, and a custom firmware with a free software userspace is available. The firmware configures the modem as a USB audio interface, handling call audio, while SMS and mobile data work out of the box.

Obtaining an M.2 version of the EG25-G compatible with the T480 is challenging, and conversion cables for the antenna connectors are required, which are described as finicky. Despite these hurdles, the setup allows users to replace their mobile phone entirely. The laptop can also run Android apps natively using Waydroid.
chinese_title: 将ThinkPad T480用作手机
chinese_summary:
文章描述了如何将ThinkPad T480笔记本电脑改造成一部功能完整的手机，支持通话、短信和移动数据。T480配备了一个用于LTE调制解调器的SIM卡槽，但音频传输引脚（PCM）未连接。英特尔管理引擎中的一个漏洞允许刷写Libreboot固件，从而绕过无线网卡白名单，使自定义调制解调器得以使用。

推荐的调制解调器是PinePhone所用的Quectel EG25-G。该调制解调器包含一个运行Android系统的ARM核心，并且提供了带有自由软件用户空间的自定义固件。该固件将调制解调器配置为USB音频接口，用于处理通话音频，而短信和移动数据则开箱即用。

获得与T480兼容的M.2版本EG25-G存在困难，且需要天线接口转换线缆，这些线缆被描述为难以操作。尽管存在这些障碍，该设置仍允许用户完全取代手机。此外，笔记本电脑还可通过Waydroid原生运行Android应用。

title: Using sed to make indexes for books (long) (1997)
summary:
This article (1997) by Eric Pement describes using `sed` to create book indexes. The process starts with a sorted input file where each line contains an index term and a page number separated by a semicolon (e.g., `Buddhism, Zen; 1`). The file is first sorted using GNU `sort` with case-insensitive and numeric-aware options: `sort -t";" +0f -1 +1n input.file`.

The goal is to consolidate multiple page numbers for the same term into a single line, replacing semicolons with commas (e.g., `Adam, 13, 21, 30-32`). Pement presents a `sed` script that uses a `N` command to read two lines, checks if they share the same index term, and if so, merges them by deleting the newline and the repeated term. A `t loop` branch handles repeated merging; otherwise, the semicolon is replaced with a comma and the first line is printed.

However, the script fails if any input line lacks a semicolon (e.g., `atheism, 9`). This causes the substitution to skip, and the subsequent `s/;/,/` erroneously removes the semicolon from the *next* line, breaking all following lines.

Pement offers two fixes: (1) Add error-checking at the start to abort the script (`/;/!`) with a message and line number for any missing semicolon; (2) Use a more restrictive regex (`s/^\(.[A-Za-z"'{}() .,/?-]*\);/\1,/`) to only replace semicolons before the newline, but this prints bad lines without merging. He prefers the first solution, which halts on errors. The final script also checks for lines with two semicolons. The article concludes with the complete, annotated `INDEXER.SED v1.2` script.
chinese_title: 使用sed制作书籍索引（长文）（1997）
chinese_summary:
本文（1997年，作者Eric Pement）介绍了如何使用`sed`创建书籍索引。流程始于一个已排序的输入文件，其中每行包含一个索引词条和一个页码，两者用分号分隔（例如：`Buddhism, Zen; 1`）。文件首先通过GNU `sort`进行排序，使用不区分大小写且识别数字的选项：`sort -t";" +0f -1 +1n input.file`。

目标是将同一词条的多个页码合并到一行中，并将分号替换为逗号（例如：`Adam, 13, 21, 30-32`）。Pement提供了一个`sed`脚本，该脚本使用`N`命令读取两行，检查它们是否共享相同的索引词条，如果是，则通过删除换行符和重复词条来合并两者。通过`t loop`分支处理重复合并；否则，将分号替换为逗号并打印第一行。

然而，如果任何输入行缺少分号（例如：`atheism, 9`），该脚本将失败。这会导致替换操作跳过，随后的`s/;/,/`会错误地删除*下一行*中的分号，从而破坏后续所有行。

Pement提供了两种修复方法：（1）在脚本开头添加错误检查（`/;/!`），在缺少分号时中止脚本并显示消息和行号；（2）使用更严格的正则表达式（`s/^\(.[A-Za-z"'{}() .,/?-]*\);/\1,/`）仅替换换行符前的分号，但这种做法会直接输出有问题的行而不进行合并。他更倾向于第一种解决方案，即在出错时停止。最终的脚本还检查了包含两个分号的行。文章最后给出了完整带注释的`INDEXER.SED v1.2`脚本。

title: Thoughts on Integers (2023)
summary:
The article argues that modern programming languages should adopt address-sized signed integers as defaults for sizes and indexes, contrary to Rust’s unsigned `usize`. The author critiques languages like C, C#, Go, and Swift for having biased defaults (usually signed `int`) but also finds Rust’s unsigned `usize` impractical in other languages due to excessive casting. Key points:

- Signed overflow is undefined behavior in C, which enables compiler optimizations (e.g., eliding wraparound checks) but can be avoided with address-sized types.
- Unsigned integers cause subtle bugs: loops from n to 0 become infinite; subtraction underflow yields large numbers that are hard to detect. Signed integers produce negative results immediately, making errors catchable via simple assertions.
- Wrapping on overflow (instead of panic) is acceptable in release builds for performance; debug builds can check.
- Address-sized integers avoid mixing pointer and 32-bit sizes, eliminating performance penalties from forced wraparound.
- Bounds checks with signed indexes (checking both `i >= 0` and `i < count`) aren’t slower because modern CPUs parallelize the two comparisons.

The author concludes that signed, address-sized integers with wrapping overflow and liberal use of assertions offer a pragmatic middle ground between safety and performance, rejecting the dogma that unsigned types are inherently safer for non‑negative values.
chinese_title: 整数思考 (2023)
chinese_summary:
该文认为，现代编程语言应将地址大小的有符号整数作为尺寸和索引的默认类型，这与Rust的无符号`usize`相悖。作者批评了C、C#、Go和Swift等语言存在有偏的默认值（通常是有符号`int`），但也指出Rust的无符号`usize`在其他语言中因过度类型转换而不实用。关键要点如下：

- C语言中有符号溢出是未定义行为，这有利于编译器优化（如省略环绕检查），但通过地址大小类型可避免此问题。
- 无符号整数会导致细微错误：从n到0的循环变为无限循环；减法下溢产生难以检测的大数值。而有符号整数会立即产生负数结果，通过简单断言即可捕获错误。
- 在发布版本中，为性能考虑可接受溢出时的环绕（而非触发恐慌）；调试版本则可进行检查。
- 地址大小的整数避免了指针与32位尺寸的混用，消除了强制环绕带来的性能损失。
- 使用有符号索引进行边界检查（同时检查`i >= 0`和`i < count`）不会更慢，因为现代CPU可并行处理这两个比较。

作者总结认为，采用支持环绕溢出的有符号地址大小整数，并配合大量使用断言，是在安全性与性能之间务实的折中方案，拒绝了“无符号类型对非负值天生更安全”的教条。

title: What's Under Your Feet in New York City?
summary: Beneath New York City’s streets lies a complex “root system” of utilities that makes the city possible. **Water lines** run in a grid pattern for redundancy and constant flow, are gravity-fed from upstate (no filtration needed), and include over 900 sampling stations. **Electrical lines** are 85% underground, using a unique “secondary network” with multiple redundant feeders and network transformers that can operate submerged. This provides high reliability but contributes to NYC’s high electricity costs. The city also operates the world’s largest **district steam heating network** (mostly in Manhattan), used for heating, hot water, sterilization, and even air conditioning. Steam pipes require careful handling of thermal expansion and condensation. **Natural gas** lines are common but face future limits on new construction. **Telecommunications** (phone, cable, fiber) run through standardized ducts managed by Empire City Subway, but older infrastructure is often poorly mapped, creating a “spaghetti” of tangled lines. **Sewers** are deeper, relying on gravity. Many abandoned utilities (e.g., a 27-mile pneumatic tube mail system) remain in place. Repairs are challenging due to density, old brittle materials, and incomplete records; vacuum excavation helps safely expose utilities. Overall, the underground world is a crowded, aging, but essential network that supports life above ground.

title: GrapheneOS protections against data extraction from locked devices
summary:
GrapheneOS provides robust defenses against data extraction from locked devices, building on Android's standard features and leveraging Pixel hardware's secure element with hardware-backed rate limiting and insider attack resistance. Key protections include:

- **Disk encryption** with strong resistance; attackers must exploit the OS in After First Unlock state or brute-force the PIN/password.
- **Secure element rate limiting**: only 20 attempts allowed; delays ramp up to 4 hours after 10 attempts and 41 days after 15. Insider attack resistance requires owner authentication to update secure element firmware, preventing government coercion.
- **Extended password length**: up to 128 characters for high-entropy diceware passphrases.
- **2nd factor fingerprint PIN**: reduces fingerprint attempts to 5; a valid fingerprint prompts for a short PIN, enabling strong passphrases without sacrificing convenience.
- **Exploit protections**: hardened memory allocators, hardware memory tagging (MTE), and physical attack defenses like blocking USB connections when locked.
- **Auto-reboot timer**: defaults to 18 hours, returning the device to Before First Unlock state with memory zeroing, even during boot.
- **Per-user encryption**: separate keys for secondary users and Private Space; GrapheneOS adds end-session features to re-lock them without rebooting.
- **Duress PIN/password**: wipes the entire device when entered in any authentication prompt (including 2nd factor), providing complete data destruction under coercion.

These features form a comprehensive security system, not relying on any single protection. For full details, see the GrapheneOS features page and release notes.

title: Show HN: Reverse Minesweeper
summary:
The article introduces **Reverse Minesweeper**, a logic puzzle where numbers indicate flowers around a tile. The game offers customizable difficulty (Beginner to Insane) and daily puzzles. A built-in solver analyses puzzles using five deduction techniques:

- **Basic** (Easy): single clue settles its squares.
- **Subset** (Medium): comparing two clues where one sees all squares of the other.
- **Overlap** (Hard): using shared squares’ min/max bounds.
- **What-if** (Extreme): hypothetical planting leads to contradiction.
- **Either-way** (Insane): both hypotheses agree on a square without contradiction.

Each tier corresponds to the hardest technique required. A 0–100 score places a grid within its tier’s band (e.g., Easy 4–19, Insane 80–100). Estimated solving times are provided per deduction type. Zero-clue rules vary by difficulty (Easy/Medium may have 1–2 zeros; Hard 1; Extreme/Insane none). Users can adjust sliders (e.g., minimum subset moves, what-if chain depth) to tune puzzle generation; the engine tries up to 90 candidates per request. The game also includes tutorials, a skip option, and a “plant” mechanic (double-tap).

title: Some more things about Django I've been enjoying
summary:
The author describes their journey learning Django to build a backend-focused website with SQL and server-rendered HTML, reminiscent of 2010s-style web development. Previously comfortable with static sites, JavaScript-heavy frontends, or Go backends, they now appreciate keeping logic in one place—the backend.

**Enjoyed Django features:**
- **Query builders**: Defining custom queryset methods (e.g., `.approved()`, `.future()`) makes filtering readable and reusable.
- **Template filters**: Handy tools like `urlize`, `date`, `json_script`, and especially `{% querystring %}` for modifying query strings in links.
- **Automatic migrations**: Easily alter models and generate migrations, enabling iterative database changes.

**Dislikes:**
- **Class-based views with inheritance**: Felt unintuitive; switched to function-based views, which are more straightforward. The author acknowledges this is a personal preference, not a "right" approach.

**Performance observations:**
- Initial load testing showed ~2–3 requests/second on a $10/month VM. After re-enabling the cached template loader (accidentally disabled), throughput improved to ~12 requests/second.
- Emphasizes that CPU profiling (e.g., with `py-spy`) is more useful than assuming database issues—SQLite bottlenecks also appear in CPU profiles.
- Acknowledges confusion around Django’s settings file and potential misconfigurations.

The author plans to continue exploring Django, focusing on learning rather than deep performance optimization.

title: Sum of Cubes via Difference Tables
summary:
The article describes an alternative method to derive the formula for the sum of cubes \( \sum_{m=1}^n m^3 = \frac{1}{4}n^2(n+1)^2 \) using finite difference tables. The author generates values for \( n \) and the sum \( N \), computes successive differences, and finds that the fourth differences are constant (value 6). This indicates \( N \) is a fourth-degree polynomial. The constant difference gives the leading coefficient \( a_4 = 6/24 = 1/4 \).

The remaining coefficients are determined by solving simultaneous equations (using Python, Mathematica, or a spreadsheet) or via an iterative subtraction method: subtract \( \frac{1}{4}n^4 \) from \( N \), compute a new table whose third differences are constant (value 3) → \( a_3 = 1/2 \); subtract \( \frac{1}{2}n^3 \), second differences constant (value 1/2) → \( a_2 = 1/4 \); subtract \( \frac{1}{4}n^2 \), all remainders are zero → \( a_1 = a_0 = 0 \). The final polynomial simplifies to \( \frac{1}{4}n^2(n+1)^2 \).

The author contrasts this systematic "crank-turning" approach with the more ingenious graphical method from a Numberphile video, highlighting the reliability of difference tables when creativity is not required.

剩余系数通过解联立方程（使用Python、Mathematica或电子表格）或迭代相减法确定：从 \(N\) 中减去 \(\frac{1}{4}n^4\)，计算新表格，其三阶差分为常数（值为3）→ \(a_3 = 1/2\)；减去 \(\frac{1}{2}n^3\)，二阶差分为常数（值为1/2）→ \(a_2 = 1/4\)；减去 \(\frac{1}{4}n^2\)，所有余数为零→ \(a_1 = a_0 = 0\)。最终多项式简化为 \(\frac{1}{4}n^2(n+1)^2\)。

title: A shell colon does nothing. Use it anyway
summary:
The article highlights the versatile **shell colon (`:`)**, the null command that evaluates its arguments but discards the result. Its main uses include:

- **Argument validation**: `${1:?missing argument}` prints an error and exits if a variable is unset or empty.
- **Setting defaults**: `: "${DATA_DIR:=/var/data}"` sets a default value while avoiding typos from repeating variable names.
- **File truncation**: `: > error.log` empties a file; multiple files can be truncated in one line.
- **Readability/writability checks**: `(: < dataset.json)` returns success if the file is readable.
- **No-op placeholder**: `trap : INT` provides a required command to `trap`; `if ... then :` satisfies branches needing a command.
- **Safety with `set -u`**: `: "$DEPLOY_ENV" "$HOST"` asserts variables are set without executing them as commands.

The article explains that parameter expansion happens regardless, but without the colon the shell tries to run the resulting string as a command. It defends readability by emphasizing that `:` fits where a command is syntactically required but no action is desired. Real-world usage includes using `:` as a Git editor for non-interactive rebases.
chinese_title: shell冒号什么都不做。但请继续使用它。
chinese_summary:
本文介绍了多功能的 **shell 冒号 (`:`)**，即空命令，它会计算参数但丢弃结果。其主要用途包括：

- **参数验证**：`${1:?missing argument}` 在变量未设置或为空时打印错误并退出。
- **设置默认值**：`: "${DATA_DIR:=/var/data}"` 设置默认值，同时避免重复变量名导致的拼写错误。
- **文件截断**：`: > error.log` 清空文件；可在一行中截断多个文件。
- **可读性/可写性检查**：`(: < dataset.json)` 若文件可读则返回成功。
- **空操作占位符**：`trap : INT` 为 `trap` 提供必需的命令；`if ... then :` 满足需要命令的分支。
- **与 `set -u` 配合使用**：`: "$DEPLOY_ENV" "$HOST"` 断言变量已设置，而不将其作为命令执行。

文章解释参数展开无论如何都会发生，但如果没有冒号，shell 会尝试将结果字符串作为命令执行。它通过强调 `:` 适用于语法上需要命令但无需执行任何操作的位置来捍卫可读性。实际使用包括在非交互式变基中将 `:` 用作 Git 编辑器。

title: Rethinking legal education in the AI era
summary:
The University of Chicago Law School’s July 2026 memo outlines its strategic vision for adapting legal education to AI, based on extensive consultation and experience since ChatGPT’s release. Three core themes guide the approach: (1) developing AI-resilient pedagogy that rewards effortful engagement, (2) elevating essential human skills (e.g., oral advocacy, strategic judgment, client relationships), and (3) teaching responsible, effective, and ethical AI use—focusing on analytical skills to adapt as technology evolves.

Specific policies are being piloted in the 2026–2027 academic year:

- **1L core courses**: Prohibit electronic devices in class (with exceptions for scribes, polling, accommodations) and use in-class exams without internet access; continue Socratic method.
- **1L Legal Research & Writing**: Treat writing without AI as foundation, then layer writing with AI for research, revision, and critique; students review both writing and AI use with instructors.
- **Elective courses**: Default options (no-device, in-class exams) but encourage experimentation with formative assessments, group projects, and AI-based tools; expand AI-focused electives.
- **Upper-level writing (SRP)**: Add a mandatory oral discussion with the supervising professor (one-on-one or workshop-style) after the final draft to probe reasoning and ensure AI-resilience.

The memo emphasizes consistent norms for foundational courses while allowing flexibility in upper-level curricula, balancing rigorous independent thinking with practical AI readiness.

title: French firefighters face 'pyrocumulonimbus' for first time

summary:

Users can revert to the old set with `select = ["E4", "E7", "E9", "F"]`.

Stabilized rules (no longer preview) include AIR303, CPY001, FURB164, FURB192, ISC004, LOG004, PLE0304, PLR0917, PLR1708, RUF036, RUF063, RUF068. Several other behavior stabilizations apply to rules like BLE001, FA102, INT001–003, S310, S508, S509, and UP019.

title: Systemd Linger
summary:
The article discusses Systemd's "linger" feature and its relationship to user process management. It explains that systemd-logind's `KillUserProcesses` option (disabled by default in recent Debian) can kill user processes like screen/tmux/nohup on logout—a feature useful for cleaning up misbehaving KDE services. However, enabling linger is not required for screen/tmux to work; it primarily allows user services to start before login.

Commands to manage linger: `loginctl enable-linger`/`disable-linger` (user or with root for others). Linger status is only detectable via `ls /var/lib/systemd/linger`.

On Debian with default settings, processes are not killed on logout; linger mainly pre-starts programs (e.g., Pipewire, Bluetooth) before the user logs in. The author found linger helpful for auto-connecting WiFi on boot without login, enabling SSH access even when X11/Wayland login is broken. A practical example: an LLM install script enabled linger unnecessarily, assuming it was needed for nohup. Overall, linger offers convenience for background services and remote access but is often misunderstood.

在Debian默认设置下，进程不会在退出登录时被终止；linger主要是在用户登录前预启动程序（例如Pipewire、蓝牙）。作者发现linger有助于在开机时无需登录即可自动连接WiFi，即使X11/Wayland登录出现问题也能启用SSH访问。一个实际案例：某个LLM安装脚本不必要地启用了linger，以为nohup需要它。总体而言，linger为后台服务和远程访问提供了便利，但常被误解。

title: How AST-grep Rewrote Tree-sitter in Rust and Made It 30% Faster
summary:
The article describes how ast-grep (a structural code-search tool) rewrote Tree-sitter’s C core in Rust using AI assistance, achieving roughly 30% faster parsing and 22% faster end-to-end performance in ast-grep. Memory usage increased about 8 MiB (peak 91 MiB on stress tests, down from >1 GiB earlier). The rewrite removed incremental parsing and native WebAssembly grammar loading, targeting file-at-a-time analysis for AI coding agents rather than editor use. Existing grammars remain compatible via preserved ABI.

An initial optimization attempt failed due to unreadable, segfault-prone code. The project then reduced scope (deleted incremental reuse and Wasm loading) and refactored the retained runtime into more idiomatic Rust with better ownership and modularity. Key optimizations: avoid building the graph‑structured stack until ambiguity actually occurs; use arena allocation for syntax nodes; compact indexes; pre‑compute common lookups; give ordinary ASCII and simple parser actions a fast path. The result is a narrower, faster runtime that is not a 1:1 replacement for upstream Tree‑sitter but serves agent‑tool workloads efficiently. This is Part 1 of a multi‑part series.

title: Alien World Chemistry Found Inside Meteorite That Struck New Jersey Home
summary:
A rare meteorite that crashed through a New Jersey home in July 2024 has yielded unprecedented insights into early solar system chemistry. Named Hillsborough, it is only the second witnessed fall of a CM1/2 carbonaceous chondrite, a primitive type preserving fragile minerals and organic compounds. The homeowner immediately preserved the fragments, allowing scientists to study pristine samples.

Analysis revealed that the meteorite originated from near the surface of its parent asteroid, where concentrated salty fluids (brines) altered the rock—a process not previously observed in this meteorite type. The brines may have helped create prebiotic molecules, including amino acids and other carbon-bearing compounds. The meteorite contains 1.8% carbon and 0.07% nitrogen, with isotopic signatures typical of CM-type meteorites.

The research, published in *Science Advances* and led by the SETI Institute, concludes that such organic delivery by carbonaceous chondrites likely contributed to the early Earth's prebiotic inventory. The study highlights the role of water, brines, and asteroid chemistry in shaping organic matter before life emerged. Some fragments will be curated at the American Museum of Natural History.
chinese_title: 新泽西住宅遭陨石撞击，内部发现外星世界化学物质
chinese_summary:
一块于2024年7月罕见陨石坠落穿过新泽西州一处住宅，为早期太阳系化学研究提供了前所未有的见解。这块名为"希尔斯伯勒"的陨石是仅有的第二例被观测到坠落的CM1/2型碳质球粒陨石，属于保留脆弱矿物与有机化合物的原始类型。屋主立即保存了碎片，使科学家得以研究原始样本。

分析显示，该陨石源自其母小行星的近地表区域，那里高浓度盐水曾改变岩石——这一过程此前从未在该类型陨石中发现。这些盐水可能促进了前生物分子的形成，包括氨基酸及其他含碳化合物。该陨石含碳量1.8%、含氮量0.07%，其同位素特征与CM型陨石一致。

这项由SETI研究所主导、发表于《科学进展》的研究得出结论：碳质球粒陨石输送的此类有机物可能为早期地球的前生物物质库作出贡献。研究突显了水、盐水及小行星化学在生命出现前塑造有机物质中的作用。部分碎片将由美国自然历史博物馆收藏。
